blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all six pose renders shows exposed upper thighs remain prominent in sit and crouch. The current surface-ray measurements show shorts coverage of 15.59% per thigh in sit and 22.82% per thigh in crouch, up from V87's 13.11% and 16.72% respectively, but still far from a continuous usable covering surface. Overskirt thigh coverage is 18.64%/18.53% in sit and 32.77%/32.88% in crouch. These prototype measurements do not establish fit or buyer usability.

Direct inspection of neutral, sit, and crouch renders shows the four-panel under-shorts plus gusset remain visually discontinuous around the moving thighs; the sit/crouch pose produces large uncovered areas and fragmented triangular crotch/side openings. The hem extension gave only a small measured coverage increase and does not validate drape, seam integrity, collision, or fit.

Front, back, left, right, three-quarter, sit, and crouch views still show pronounced side corrugation, projecting irregular hem corners, and sharp unsupported panel splay. The silhouette remains an unapproved prototype.

The V88 product build report and geometry audit still reject avatarFitVerified and buildReportPassed. The hash-bound skin export independently records 0 unweighted vertices and passing per-object weight audits; that does not prove fit, shape-key response, or acceptable deformation. UV, Unity prefab, and VRChat runtime evidence remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
